description: This file defines a singly linked list implementation in Kotlin, including methods for adding, removing, retrieving elements by index, and calculating the size.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A mutable singly linked list for String elements with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index in the list.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private helper method to unlink a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Private companion object method to find the last node in the list.
